msg: The jaeger and jaeger_thrift exporters were removed from the Collector (contrib v0.107.0); export with otlp to Jaeger's OTLP port 4317 instead.
The logging exporter was deprecated and then removed; rename it to debug: and move its loglevel to verbosity.
loglevel was dropped from the console exporter; the debug exporter takes verbosity: basic|normal|detailed.
The opencensus exporter is deprecated and unmaintained; send OTLP and let the receiving backend translate.
The opencensus receiver is deprecated; point OpenCensus senders at an otlp receiver or a bridge.
remote_sampling was removed from the jaeger receiver; move it to the jaegerremotesampling extension.
The memory_ballast extension was removed from the Collector; set the GOMEMLIMIT environment variable instead.
service.telemetry.metrics.address is deprecated in favour of service.telemetry.metrics.readers with a Prometheus reader block.
OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN only controlled the migration window; instrumentations that finished the migration ignore it and emit the stable names unconditionally.
